cohort: 161 women in the active phase of labor having one previous cesarean section
finding: Lower uterine segment thickness of 2.3 mm and myometrial thickness of 1.9 mm during the first stage of labor are associated with a high risk of uterine defects during a labor trial.
mod_finding: Lower uterine segment thickness (OR = 0.41, 95%CI 0.22-0.76) and myometrial thickness (OR = 0.33, 95%CI 0.16-0.66) were also significantly associated with cesarean section delivery.
